svg.title: Physical reinsertion and the strong-coupling boundary

cc:Work.dc:title: Physical reinsertion and the strong-coupling boundary
cc:Work.dc:description: The one-carrier enhanced-dissipation branch changes the normalized numerator from epsilon^(7/3) to epsilon^(11/6) and enlarges the scale window from R^(2/3) log R to R^(4/3) (log R)^2. The result is unconditional only for the declared one-carrier family, remains insufficient at fixed R and arbitrarily large coupling, and extends to multiple carriers only under a full-superposition integrated enhanced-dissipation hypothesis with constants uniform over the compared family.
